scope: Root-approved changes to genuinely superseded 0.2 expectations after R11 freezes. Original 0.1 source/model/texture/timing, strict historical source data, physical negatives, fixed anatomy and lifetime checks remain required.

items.old: One .9-second source orbit played once in .72/.50 wall seconds
items.new: A seeded actor-owned random2–3 second wall budget spans several complete support-step source loops before each new bout; hit-confirmed low-HP continuation strikes remain finite.

items.old: Every nonlethal heavy/bash enters the R8 knockdown fall and later get-up
items.new: Nonlethal heavy/bash uses a standing authored backward brace/shove; only lethal damage selects the separately authored collapse.

items.old: Player block freezes the attacking clip with one second of stagger
items.new: A contacting block consumes the strike, flashes the wolf and immediately advances an actual hit reaction without a forced fall or recoil impulse.

items.old: Current short bite IDs use R10 Driving_Bite and Driving_Cross_Bite
items.new: Current IDs use the separately authored R11 Predator diagonal/reverse bites; R9/R10 source-data and historical sampler checks remain explicit.

items.old: All R9/R10 extra wrappers are installed on every live actor
items.new: Only active R10 orbit clips and R11 motions are installed in production. Historical pose checks install their wrappers into an isolated test-only fixture; active clip count does not prove quality.

items.old: Runtime head counter-aim may reduce the diagonal under a bounded yaw/pitch envelope
items.new: R11 authored attack attention preserves the large upper-body and muzzle trajectory; legacy long attacks still keep their own bounded aim and body commitment rules.

items.new: Close pursuit remains6.6m/s; farther pursuit can accelerate to9.2m/s with matched actual source cadence and original run-loop offset.

items.old: Original R8 knockdown clip is the final lethal identity
items.new: Natural collapse has a separate R11 identity and relaxed endpoint, with the same defeat reward/control release and corpse cleanup ownership.

items.old: Blocked orbit directions required an attack within8frames; moving-player pursuit forced only legacy flankRemaining=20 and constant6.6m/s cap.
items.new: Blocked directions preserve the full seeded2.5s observation budget, then choose a genuinely reachable attack. Blocked sight must prevent attack/damage and hold safe position. Moving-player pursuit follows completed observation and uses the current acceleration-limited speed, with all original positional/radius/bone-scale tolerances retained.
